content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Contrary to the planner's assumption, an insurance covenant does exist at § 7 ¶ 14 (p0048). It carries workers' compensation as required by statute, CGL of USD 1,000,000, E&O of USD 1,000,000, and certificates/evidence of insurance on Company request with notice of material change — so the general liability, workers' comp and certificate elements are satisfied, and E&O sits at the playbook fallback level (USD 1M rather than the preferred USD 2M), which we note but do not redline. The material gap is cyber/privacy liability, which the fallback requires at USD 2,000,000. Contractor plainly touches our data: Confidential Information is defined at p0038 as documents, software, reports, data and records obtained by Contractor from Company in performing Services, and p0007 contemplates Contractor personnel working at Company facilities and accessing Company computer systems. With no cyber coverage at all for a vendor that handles our data and systems, the clause fails the fallback on that term. Minimal fix: insert cyber liability (network security and privacy) coverage of USD 5,000,000, scoped to where Contractor processes Company data, leaving the remaining coverages and the existing certificate mechanic untouched; USD 2,000,000 is offered as the fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Add cyber/privacy liability coverage to the existing insurance covenant, since Contractor handles Company data and accesses Company systems.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The insurance covenant covers workers' compensation, general liability and E&O but omits cyber/privacy coverage, and Contractor accesses our systems and handles our data and Confidential Information. We have added cyber liability insurance of USD 5,000,000 per our playbook; we can accept USD 2,000,000 if that better matches your current program.
